tokenize_text: tokenize a string or list of strings into CLIP token tensors with context length 77
create_simple_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance with a custom BPE vocab file path and special tokens
encode_text: encode a text string into a list of BPE token IDs using the SimpleTokenizer
decode_tokens: decode a list of token IDs back into human-readable text using the SimpleTokenizer
clean_text: clean text by fixing unicode with ftfy and unescaping HTML entities using basic_clean
